fiwareDescription: Orion is a C++ implementation of the NGSIv2 REST API binding developed as a part of the FIWARE platform. Orion Context Broker allows you to manage the entire lifecycle of context information including updates, queries, registrations and subscriptions. It is an NGSIv2 server implementation to manage context information and its availability. Using the Orion Context Broker, you are able to create context elements and manage them through updates and queries. In addition, you can subscribe to context information so when some condition occurs (e.g. the context elements have changed) you receive a notification. These usage scenarios and the Orion Context Broker features are described in this documentation.
ngsiLdBrokerManagerDescription: NGSI-LD Broker Manager is an interoperability gateway that bridges the communication between Idra and the Orion Context Broker. Its main role is to transform and map federated metadata catalogues in Idra represented in the DCAT-AP standard into NGSI-LD entities, enabling their storage in Orion and management within the NGSI-LD context management ecosystem. By harmonizing heterogeneous metadata models and facilitating semantic translation between standards, the component enhances interoperability across data providers, federation services, and context-based applications within the SMART ERA Data Platform.
idraDescription: Idra is a web application able to federate existing Open Data Management Systems (ODMS) based on different technologies providing a unique access point to search and discover open datasets coming from heterogeneous sources. Idra uniforms representation of collected open datasets, thanks to the adoption of international standards (DCAT-AP) and provides a set of RESTful APIs to be used by third party applications. Idra supports natively ODMS based on CKAN, DKAN, Socrata, Orion Context Broker (NGSI v2) and many other technologies: Idra provides also a set of APIs to federate ODMS not natively supported. In addition, it is possible to federate generic open data portals, that don't expose API, using the web scraping functionality or providing a dump file of the datasets in DCAT-AP format. Furthermore, Idra provides a SPARQL endpoint in order to perform queries on 5 stars RDF linked open data collected from federated ODMS and allows to easily create charts based on federated open datasets (through DatalEt-Ecosystem Provider DEEP) Idra is an open source software developed by Engineering Ingegneria Informatica SpA.
dmmDescription: The Data Model Mapper tool enables to convert several file types (e.g. CSV, Json, GeoJson) to the different Data Models defined in the SynchroniCity Project. The files in input can contain either rows, JSON objects or GeoJson Features, each of them representing an object to be mapped to an NGSI entity, according to the selected Data Model. In particular, it performs following steps: Parse input file, by converting it into a row/object stream; Streaming: Each row/object coming from the stream is converted to an intermediate object. Mapping: By using the input JSON Map, convert the intermediate object to an NGSI entity, according to a specific target Data Model. Validation and report: Validate resulting object against the JSON schema corresponding to a target Data Model. It leverages AJV JSON Schema Validator. Produce a report file with validated and unvalidated objects. Writing: Orion CB or File Validated objects are sent to the configured Orion Context Broker and/or to a local file. The tool is an open source software developed by Engineering Ingegneria Informatica SpA.
osmDescription: OpenStreetMap (OSM) is a free, open geographic database updated and maintained by a community of volunteers via open collaboration. Contributors collect data from surveys, trace from aerial imagery and also import from other freely licensed geodata sources. OpenStreetMap is freely licensed under the Open Database License and as a result commonly used to make electronic maps, inform turn-by-turn navigation, assist in humanitarian aid and data visualisation. OpenStreetMap uses its own topology to store geographical features which can then be exported into other GIS file formats. The OpenStreetMap website itself is an online map, geodata search engine and editor. Provides information regarding POI, locations, streets, roads, and other relevant geographical locations, as well as, be used as a database to store newly created geographical open data. The tool is not accessible directly, but is integrated within the SMARTERA dashboard, in particular through scripts developed and inserted into the Data-space section.

queryEngineDescription: Query engine suite is a tool used to query data from different sources (Minio, Orion, custom api) with different types of query (SQL, key-value mongo-like, graphql and blind string search). It can be configured to allow query with user-policy restrictions and it is divided by two micro services, Query engine and Source Connector. Query engine provides the query APIs, while Source connector cache the data from sources, either with webhook or polling. A gui angular section is available, and soon will become a standalone web app.
idra_hvd_role_body: Idra is a key tool that satisfies the general requirements for publishing datasets. Since the datasets are federated in Idra according to the DCAT-AP standard, it provides access to them via standard API and provides bulk download. The tool also supports meeting the general reuse requirement regarding license application and as it supports the DCAT-AP standard.
fiware_hvd_role_body: FIWARE Orion Context Broker is a key tool that meets the general requirements for reusing datasets. Since the greater the interoperability, the more reuse is encouraged, the Context Broker is a tool that promote interoperability by allowing the adoption of common data models. The Context Broker also meets the general requirements for publishing since it supports the NGSI-v2/LD API standards.
ckan_hvd_role_body: CKAN is a key tool that satisfies the general requirements for publishing datasets. Since the datasets are federated according to the DCAT-AP standard, it provides access to them via standard API and provides bulk download. The tool also supports meeting the general reuse requirement regarding license application and as it supports the DCAT-AP standard.
dmm_hvd_role_body: Data model mapper is a key tool that meets the general requirements for reusing datasets. It allows to transform and model the internal structure of a dataset so that it follows a precise common data model, such as a Smart data model, promoting interoperability.
public_tool_Content:
To support rural communities, local authorities, and regional stakeholders across Europe in sharing and accessing integrated data, the SMART ERA project has developed a set of open datasets collected from rural pilot regions.
The publication of these datasets enables organizations and public bodies across the EU to reuse open data for the development of innovative rural services and evidence-based policies.
The tools on this page allow users to access and browse these datasets, which served as input for the pilot services implemented across the project's European regions. These pilots address challenges in the areas of rural mobility, environmental monitoring, community governance and socio-economic development across various EU rural regions.
All datasets are open, provided in machine-readable formats and accessible via APIs, through both the European Data Portal and national open data portals.

homepage_showcase.title: SMART community-led transition for Europe's Rural Areas
homepage_showcase.description: SMART ERA (SMART community-led transition for Europe's Rural Areas - 2023 to 2027) aims at empowering rural communities for a sustainable transition and foster cooperation across EU regions. The project will establish a European-wide rural data screening solution, engaging residents in co-design, offering a unified Smartness/Digital Maturity assessment, and providing evidence-based recommendations for policy enhancement.
homepage_showcase.description_2: Rural areas are often considered outdated, with limited services and an ageing population. However, they are now on the verge of a digital and green revolution, which could reverse migration trends.
homepage_showcase.description_3: SMART ERA is set to breathe new life into rural areas by providing smart innovation packages (SIPs) to combat depopulation and address socio-economic and environmental challenges. SMART ERA is spearheading a community-centric transformation encompassing technology, governance, business, society, and policymaking.
homepage_showcase.data_dashboard_subtitle: This is the Data Platform Hub, the access point to SMART ERA's Data Platform.
homepage_showcase.data_dashboard_closing: The Data Platform can therefore be used either as an integrated end-to-end data ecosystem or as a set of standalone, reusable tools that can be combined according to specific data management requirements.

homepage_showcase.data_platform_architecture_lead: The SMART ERA Data Platform is an advanced modular data management ecosystem designed to collect, harmonize, store, and federate heterogeneous data, ensuring maximum accessibility and interoperability.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_architecture_bullet1_text: Empower rural communities through evidence-based data insights and unified rural smartness indicators.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_architecture_bullet2_text: Full compliance with EU guidelines, DCAT-AP catalogs, and machine-readable data formats.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_architecture_bullet3_text: Robust and scalable backend engineered to support regional decision-making and AI services.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_graphql_title: Data Backbone for the Data Dashboard
homepage_showcase.data_platform_graphql_intro: The Data Platform operates as the core backend layer dedicated to powering analytical visualization services:
homepage_showcase.data_platform_graphql_bullet1_text: Targeted, flexible queries for client-side data consumption with minimal network latency.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_graphql_bullet2_text: The platform in addition provides SQL endpoints and key-value query mechanisms, enabling users and applications to discover, query and retrieve data through different access paradigms according to their needs.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_graphql_bullet3_text: Real-time generation of interactive charts, time series, and digital maturity indicators.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_graphql_bullet4_text: Continuous synchronization with thematic maps to monitor each European pilot area.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_pipeline_intro: The platform is built upon a modular ecosystem of software components that can operate either as a complete data management pipeline or as standalone services, providing flexibility in deployment and integration while ensuring interoperability across the entire data lifecycle, managing every phase of the data lifecycle:
homepage_showcase.data_platform_pipeline_bullet1_text: Multi-channel ingestion from heterogeneous open data portals and DCAT-AP compliant catalogs.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_pipeline_bullet2_text: Standardized representation of context information via NGSI-LD entities and RESTful interfaces.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_pipeline_bullet3_text: Automated semantic mapping guided by shared Smart Data Models schemas.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_pipeline_bullet4_text: Secure, scalable, and resilient persistence within the FIWARE Orion-LD Context Broker.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_pipeline_bullet5_text: Advanced query mechanisms and data extraction via GraphQL, SPARQL endpoints, and analytics exports.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_modular_intro: The architecture moves beyond monolithic constraints, offering total operational modularity:
homepage_showcase.data_platform_modular_bullet1_text: Independent, containerized, and easily maintainable components for specific data management needs.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_modular_bullet2_text: Tools cooperating in an orchestrated workflow to form the official SMART ERA data pipeline.
homepage_showcase.data_platform_modular_bullet3_text: Each tool (Idra, Orion, Data Model Mapper, Query Engine) can be deployed independently on external datasets.
